31440111.name: 指法深造
31440111.desc_art: 一个命令，听懂它，执行它，或者戳破它，撕咬它，砸碎它！

31440121.name: 元音启蒙
31440121.desc_art: 陌生的曲谱、丝弦与要求；陌生的心跳、想法和一片新天地。

31440131.name: 雕于躯壳的唱名
31440131.desc_art: 在尺侧，诅咒如夜色般呢喃；在桡侧，狂喜正嘶鸣呐喊。

desc: 生日是极少数的、由珐琅眼自己“决定”的事。有一天，珐琅眼听到了一支陌生的曲子，它被一个摔坏的八音盒断断续续地重复着。它叫《祝你生日快乐》，珐琅眼觉得，没有比这一天更适合作为“生日”的了。|来到箱中后，珐琅眼学会的关于“生日”的最重要仪式是：把奶油抹在所有朋友的脸上。今天她也认真做到了。|在捉迷藏的游戏中，珐琅眼蜷进了脏衣篮里，只有纸信圈儿找到了她。在纸信圈儿爬进衣服堆里后，珐琅眼开心地与她分享了十颗椰子糖。
useDesc: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。
desc2: 知晓了喜怒哀乐的音乐装置，拥有珐琅般双眼的少女，你最单纯的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪30年代，参展时长17年，据记载诞生于4月11日春。原展出地点不明，短暂展出于法国巴黎后，辗转至英伦三岛的一处保密地点。

尺寸：62 63/64×25 19/32×15 23/64in.
介质：正弦音波
香调：美食香调 榛子 香草 苦杏仁 香脂木豆
灵感：珐琅的泛音[岩] 多频谐振

character_data.title: “左胳膊”
character_data.text:
一支对神秘学波动极为敏感的“左胳膊”，险些被用作攻击笔者的凶器。
在漫长而低效的交流后，笔者没有获得它的更多信息。对她而言，这根左臂似乎与生俱来，当笔者提问“你的手为何与别人不一样”时，她反问：“难道不是每个人都会和别人有些不一样吗？”

character_data.title: 扯不破罩衫
character_data.text: 与罩衫还算精致的造型不同，面料使用了坚固耐磨的“鼹鼠皮”。在见识到受访者左臂的力气和冒失的动作后，这种面料的使用目的已不言自明。

character_data.title: 绝技皮鞋
character_data.text:
一侧绑带散开的鞋子，与罩衫上解开的羊腿袖类似，这根绑带也透露着不受管束的自由。
受访者在戒心消退后，开心地展示了奔跑时不踩到散落绑带的技巧：一种独特、精准的步幅变化，其节奏与华尔兹舞曲有所肖似。

character_data.title: 宇宙即音乐
character_data.text:
拨动弦，然后聆听。敲击铁砧，记录音调之间的关联。
“振动”易于制造，易于观察。在世界第一次认知音调与弦长比例的关系后，关于“振动”的理论一直在推陈出新。
在这些理论最为辉煌的年代，星星的升降亦是音高的升降，行星本身也被视为一种音符。美与和谐的比例，可以从音程推论至万事万物。
振动被应用于理解不可见的事物，也被用于沟通身体、灵魂与心灵。可想而知，感知所有细微的振动，便是极致的美与调和一切的基础。
这样的感知需要足够的纯净，纯净会带来绝对的专注；这也需要独特的天赋，但天赋亦需要严厉的打磨。
一颗种子被挑选出来，从封闭的蓝色培养皿中，挪去了乐器环绕的舞台上。她从此奔忙于曲谱与音符中，在她还不理解“美”、不理解“比例”，也不理解“宇宙”的时候。
她能够听懂命令，这就足够了。

character_data.title: 这不是思考
character_data.text:
片段1：
“我怎么知道她为什么会来到这儿？我遵守约定，没有透露过你们的地点。”
以无法理解和说明的原因，恰好出现在一个需要她的地方——无头杂志社。

片段2：
“我不知道是什么让她违抗命令。本能？她应该本能服从命令才对，她一向如此。”
又一条本能可以战胜命令的佐证。
是自由的力量！这只可悲的螃蟹头无法理解。

片段3：
“你们关心这个？是的，她之前被严格关押，禁止和人说话，直到现在都结结巴巴的。”
看来重塑之手里有个腓特烈二世。等等，与世隔绝？

……

结论：一位主宰自我之人，几乎已脱离宇宙奴役的完全自由者。
无处不在的理性镣铐迫使我写下这些记录。
不过，我正在学习像一个抛却思考的人那样思考，学习——她叫珐琅眼吗？不知道，但学习她的人生智慧！

character_data.title: 媒体信用
character_data.text:
白雪松：很抱歉我的神秘术吓到了你，但我听说你对一切都保有中立的好奇心。
白雪松：你曾经见过类似的传声神秘术吗？
珐琅眼：不……你们不一样，而且……
白雪松：而且？
珐琅眼：你也没有头。你把头藏在哪里了？
白雪松：这只是我采访的方式，我的头还留在我的脖子上。
珐琅眼：……我有朋友，他们也办杂志，而且没有头。
白雪松：我从未听说过这样一群同行。他们是伟大的、被历史埋没的先驱者？抑或是……
珐琅眼：我不知道。我找不到他们了。
白雪松：真是遗憾。最近几年，失去联系是很寻常的事。你考虑过刊登寻人启事吗？

character_data.title: 第一声啼鸣
character_data.text:
一顶装饰着铜管按键的软帽，硬衬布搭出骨架，由柔软的织物严密包裹。
受访者凭外观猜测，这套“原本的改造方案”说不定也包含了使脑袋变成圆号，她很庆幸自己的头顶不会有气鸣音振动，她更喜欢这顶帽子仅作为装饰的模样。

character_data.title: 音高调节器
character_data.text:
琴弦绕过共鸣腔，以旋钮调节弦长，这是一个负责音高调节的小机关。
一次细致的旋转调音之后，受访者就可以像一架怪诞而美丽的乐器般演奏音乐，如一缕偶有迷茫、至今仍在探寻自我的灵魂，困在被彻底器物化的躯体之中。旋钮可以改变音高，却没法度量灵魂。

character_data.title: “发条偶人”
character_data.text:
一双精巧的“腿”，似乎是为了可以永远舞蹈下去而设计的。
受访者的价值显然被精确地定义和衡量了，如同一个设计之初只是为了在八音盒中旋转的偶人。如果这不是一片投射而下的幻影，而是被真正落实的改造方案，她甚至只能像一个合格的演员一样，跳着舞逃离“蓝色房间”。

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 箱子里会给我留一个房间……“留”？#0|意思是，我可以随时住下，或者离开？#7.15|所以，你是一个旅馆老板吗？#13.3
character_voice.encontent: You saved me a room here ...? What do you mean "saved"?#0|... You mean I'm free to stay or leave whenever I like? #8.45|Hmm, are you a Timekeeper or an innkeeper?#14.42

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 有段时间，我以为是大人们在用开灯来决定天气——#0|一盏灯是阴天，三盏灯是雨天，关上灯是晴天……#5.95|直到有一次，没有太阳，也没有亮灯，有人大喊“停电了”……#12.9
character_voice.encontent: For a long time, I thought the weather was decided by the number of lights on:#0|three for rain, one for clouds, and zero for the sun ... until I learned that it's the other way around. #8.56|'Cause one day it was dark with no lights on, and the lords and ladies said there was a "blackout" ...#22.22

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 那些“大人们”说，最好的未来在过去。#0|我……我经常掏老鼠洞，把手伸进去时，我会害怕，但缩回手时，我就不怕了。#5.95|大人们这样说，是想把手缩回来，缩回他们不怕的地方，我知道。#16.95
character_voice.encontent: The lords and ladies told me the best future lies in the past ...#0|But I think they said that because they're scared. When I was bored in the blue room, I would reach my arm into an old mouse hole; #7.2|I wanted to explore, but when I got too scared, I'd pull my arm back out. That's kind of like what they're doing now.#22

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 你在打盹儿吗？#0|那你需要一顶更大的帽子。#1.85|戴上它，偷偷闭上眼，连宇宙都不会发现……#4.6|有个大帽子跟我说，他开会时睡觉，从来没被其他大帽子抓住过。#9.7
character_voice.encontent: You really like to nap, don't you?#0|Maybe you need a bigger hat; #5.7|one of the Big Hats told me it's a good way to trick people. #10.33|He said he's never been caught sleeping 'cause no one can tell if your eyes are closed if they can't see them!#17.1

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: ……噢，是你，小帽子维尔汀。#8.5
character_voice.encontent: ... Oh, it's you, Vertin the Small Hat.#9.7

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: ……噢，是你，小帽子维尔汀。#8.5
character_voice.encontent: ... Oh, it's you, Vertin the Small Hat.#9.7

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: ㄗㄠˇ上好！#0|我喜欢“打招呼”这条命令，但或许讲礼貌不需要命令？#3.66
character_voice.encontent: ㄍ-Good morning!#0|I never knew I should greet people until the lords and ladies told me to ... That's part of being polite, right?#4.7

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 每次不想吃早餐，我就躲在画框后，#0|听广播小姐飘过去，听盘子和碗叮铃作响，#3.74|再和那一大把向日葵捉迷藏……#8.98|你也很有趣，你从来没被吵醒过。#12.8
character_voice.encontent: When I feel like skipping breakfast, I'll go out and play hide-and-seek with the sunflower boy—#0|I like to hide behind one of the paintings, and when he's distracted by the flying radio or a food fight, #11.05|I take the chance to move around ... #22.4|How do you sleep through all those noisy noises?!#27.9

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 希望今晚我能做梦，做个好梦。#0|最近有意思的新鲜事太多了，我怎么玩也玩不够，希望梦里的我能帮帮忙……#4.95
character_voice.encontent: There are so many new things to experience here,#0|but I have to go to bed now. I wish my dreams were as fun as this place … #6.13

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 你睡得很晚，像星星。#0|你静悄悄的，不发出声音——就更像了。#3.43
character_voice.encontent: You're always still up when everyone else has gone to sleep, just like the stars in the sky,#0|and they never make a single note of sound either ... You really are just like them.#11.6

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我喜欢你的帽子。#0|我有一群朋友，他们的帽子和你的很像，但是更大，能遮住整个头……#2.3|我很想他们，你可以把帽子借我戴戴吗？#11.77
character_voice.encontent: I like your hat.#0|It reminds me of my friends; they wear the same kind of hats, only much, much bigger. #2.68|I-I miss them ... Could I borrow it for a while?#15.35

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 用左手拿冰淇淋，可以让它化得更慢，#0|这是我来箱子后发现的左手新作用。#4.03
character_voice.encontent: You know what? Ice cream melts slower in my left hand than in my right hand.#0|I never had a chance to notice that before I came to the Suitcase.#10.94

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 丝带要么打结，要么散架，纱袖卡进了关节，没法抬手……#0|所以大人们扔给我一条围裙。#6.75|围裙很好，它保护了我，弄坏衣服的处罚总是很严厉。#10.5
character_voice.encontent: The ribbons and lace on my dress used to tangle up a lot; sometimes they even got stuck in my arm's joints ...#0|so the lords and ladies made me an apron and a dress without any ribbons or laces. #14.44|It wasn't as pretty, but it did save me from a lot of yelling and punishment.#25.07

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 丝带要么打结，要么散架，纱袖卡进了关节，没法抬手……#0|所以大人们扔给我一条围裙。#6.75|围裙很好，它保护了我，弄坏衣服的处罚总是很严厉。#10.5
character_voice.encontent: The ribbons and lace on my dress used to tangle up a lot; sometimes they even got stuck in my arm's joints ...#0|so the lords and ladies made me an apron and a dress without any ribbons or laces. #14.44|It wasn't as pretty, but it did save me from a lot of yelling and punishment.#25.07

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 作为一种乐器，我应当喜欢音乐——#0|不，不，乐器没有喜好，但是我有。#4.05
character_voice.encontent: The lords and ladies said I should love music because I'm an instrument ...#0|But that's not right. I do love music, but I love it because I am Coppélia.#9.46

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 你是个好指挥，你很会把混乱的能量变和谐。#0|你在重塑乐团里也会有大出息的，肯定会！#4.76
character_voice.encontent: You are a good conductor—I see how you guide their arcane energy and make them work as a team.#0|You could make a name for yourself if-if you ever join the Manus orchestra, I'm telling you!#13.35

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 苦蜜井大人给我回了信，写了好长、好长。#0|可是，我几乎看不懂，比如这句，“你必须多学习一些……文书语法知识了。”#5.4|这是什么意思？#16.7
character_voice.encontent: I heard from Ms. Bittersweet. It was a long, long letter,#0|but I barely understood what she was talking about. Look, she said, "You need a proper education to improve your grammar." #8.85|What's that mean?#26.86

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 有个红头发的女士很可怕，我偷听到她要做实验，想把更多乐器粘在一起。#0|我不想再成为实验品了，不管她怎么叫我，我都没有回头。#7.7
character_voice.encontent: I met a red-haired lady the other day; she said she was lo-looking for new instruments for her "instrument combination experiments."#0|I got scared and ran away ... Please, don't let her know I'm here.#17.1

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我不知道怎么称呼他，或她，但当时，我认为那是另一个我。#0|当我觉得很疼，他也会惨叫，我吃饭时，那里也会传来勺子触碰餐盘的声音。#7.05|后来？他把叉子叉进了一位大人的手背，那个“我”就消失了。#16.2
character_voice.encontent: There was a time I had a friend—or maybe a different "me"—in my mind. I don't know whether they are a he or a she,#0|but we share the same feelings: they cry when I'm hurt, they chew when I eat ... #18.85|Where are they now? Mm, they-they disappeared after I tried to fight the lords and ladies.#32.3

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 最近，我在长大，不是长个子，而是另一种……#0|但在这之前，我先发现了，我很弱小、无知，也总是害怕……#6.15|你是怎么长大的，维尔汀？你为什么不会害怕？#16.65
character_voice.encontent: I've grown up a lot. No, not on the outside really,#0|but, em ... How do I put it? I can see the world is bigger than I thought and a little scarier ... #8.14|But you've grown up even more, Vertin. How-How did you learn not to be scared?#23.04

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 站在队列里？我该在1、2、3……第5个吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Get into line? Okay! I'll be number ... one, two, three ... five?#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 他们欺负你了？那我会用力的！#0
character_voice.encontent: Are they picking on you? I'll p-punish them!#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: *敲击音叉的声音*#0
character_voice.encontent: *hits her tuning fork*#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 一圈、两圈……#0
character_voice.encontent: One wave, two waves ...#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 渐强！渐强！#0
character_voice.encontent: Crescendo! Crescendo!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 去！去舞台上。#0
character_voice.encontent: Go on! Time for the show!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: *含糊的嘶吼*#0
character_voice.encontent: *roar*#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 铛铛铛！#0
character_voice.encontent: Clang! Clang!#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: *一段轻灵的哼唱*#0
character_voice.encontent: *A soft tune*#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 心脏的嗡嗡声。#0
character_voice.encontent: Follow the beat of my heart.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 演奏吧！敲响身体，敲响头！#0
character_voice.encontent: Raise your hands and start playing! Let it out!#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 演奏吧！敲响身体，敲响头！#0
character_voice.encontent: Raise your hands and start playing! Let it out!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 是我的错……#0
character_voice.encontent: I'm sorry ...#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 那些看不见的线断了，#0|太好了，指挥我的人是你。#2.8
character_voice.encontent: The invisible strings are gone! #0|Thank goodness you are such a good conductor.#7

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 那些看不见的线断了，#0|太好了，指挥我的人是你。#2.8
character_voice.encontent: The invisible strings are gone! #0|Thank goodness you are such a good conductor.#7

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我……变得更好、更厉害了吗？#0|不用换掉我的右手，也不用挖个新的共鸣箱吗？#4.65
character_voice.encontent: Th-That's it? A-Am I better and stronger already?#0|Aren't you going to install another tuning fork or add a sound box in my stomach?#9.9

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 声音在身体里回响，但没有一声是我想说的话。#0
character_voice.encontent: So many sounds echoing inside me, but none of them have my voice.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 声音在身体里回响，但没有一声是我想说的话。#0
character_voice.encontent: So many sounds echoing inside me, but none of them have my voice.#0

character_voice.name: 初遇
character_voice.content: 这是原本的改造……完整的我？#0|那是什么意思？#4.8|是像八音盒里的人偶，可以一直跳舞吗？#7
character_voice.encontent: A complete version of me ...?#0|What does that mean? #5.1|Am I able to dance like a music box doll now?#8.2

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 什么天气都要演奏，#0|如果乐器锈蚀、开裂，那就换掉……命令是这么说的。#2.1|可是，没走音的乐器同胞们，也被大网吃了……#8.3
character_voice.encontent: When I lived in the blue room, we instruments had to play every day no matter the weather.#0|If anyone got rusted or broken, they were thrown away and replaced by a new one ... #12.2|But that doesn't mean the survivors were lucky—they were all eaten by that giant net in the end ...#24.3

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 把纸带塞进八音盒，如果看错谱的方向，颠倒的曲子会变得很怪……#0|“暴雨”是和这个差不多的错误，你正在帮助时间变好听，对吗？#7.5
character_voice.encontent: Have you ever used a paper strip music box? If you put the tape in backwards, you'll hear a creepy melody ...#0|I think that's pretty much the same as what the "Storm" does, and you're trying to put the tape in the right way again, right?#15.2

character_voice.name: 孑立
character_voice.content: 你要休息一会儿吗？#0|闭上眼睛，黑色很安全，音符从耳朵里飘进来，又轻又软……#2.6|我会慢慢忘记手臂上不舒服的感觉，然后……我就睡着了。#13.4
character_voice.encontent: Why don't you give your eyes a rest?#0|It feels safe and comfortable to listen to music with your eyes closed ... #5.2|At least for me, the notes in the dark ease the pain in my arm and help me to sleep.#15.4

character_voice.name: 问候
character_voice.content: 夏利大人给我看了漂亮的布景，我想碰一碰，#0|但乐器像光一样落在我的手上，轻飘飘的，#7.3|唔……她说这只是“幻影”。#13.2
character_voice.encontent: Ms. Charlie showed me an amazing stage set the other day. The instruments were glittering, so I reached out to touch them,#0|but they just disappeared into nothing. #15.4|Hmm ... she said what I saw was only an "illusion."#23.2

character_voice.name: 朝晨
character_voice.content: 书箱子小姐给了我一张“晨读清单”，#0|她很好心，这张清单能帮我遮住早上的太阳，让我不会醒太早。#5.2
character_voice.encontent: Ms. Writing Box gave me this book list.#0|She's really nice—now I can cover my eyes from the sun in the morning.#5.8

character_voice.name: 信任-朝晨
character_voice.content: 每天早上，大家都很忙，#0|总是有许多事情在等着他们。如果不做这些事情的话，好像某些……看不见的东西就会坏掉，#3.1|唔？那叫秩序？#17.6
character_voice.encontent: Everyone seems to have lots of things to do in the morning.#0|It feels like there's ... something invisible, easily broken, that would fall apart if they didn't work so hard to keep it together. #6.2|Huh? You call that "order"?#27.3

character_voice.name: 夜暮
character_voice.content: 维尔汀，你该闭眼了——#0|这时候还睁着眼，眼睛里会被撒沙子的。#2.7
character_voice.encontent: You should go to bed, Vertin.#0|He'll throw a handful of sand into your eyes and snatch them up if you keep them open too late.#4.3

character_voice.name: 信任-夜暮
character_voice.content: 你做了太多事，#0|不需要像我一样数呼吸，也没时间在地上打滚……我还没看见你坐下，白天就全消失了。#1.8|你一定很累，我不吵你。#14.7
character_voice.encontent: You did a lot today.#0|I never even saw you sit down while I was rolling around on the ground, counting my breaths ... #3.6|I'll leave you alone.#17.25

character_voice.name: 帽檐与发鬓
character_voice.content: 我喜欢拉下帽子，遮住眼睛。#0|但现在不行，夏利大人说，这身衣服只能看，不能碰，#4.2|如果我拉帽子的话，神秘术就消失了……#12.1
character_voice.encontent: I usually like to use a headscarf to cover my eyes, but I can't do that with this bonnet. #0|Ms. Charlie said it was just for looking at #13.5|and that it would disappear if I pulled it too hard ...#18.6

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 大家总是打不开核桃，#0|但我把左手举起来，放下去……#2.9|核桃就开了。#6.8
character_voice.encontent: I don't know why so many others have been asking me to open walnuts for them.#0|What's so hard about it? Just raise your arm and smash it ... #10.1|There you go.#18.3

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 一开始是肚子，然后是左手和腿，下一步……#0|会不会是我的头？是一颗更聪明的头，还是一颗更响亮的头？#6.9
character_voice.encontent: They started with my stomach, then my left arm, and my legs would have been next ...#0|Would they eventually have replaced my head? With a smarter one? A louder one?#14.6

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 偶尔，大家会叫我帮忙，递一下墨水瓶，或者看看外面的天气……#0|荒原的天气很多变，所以有时候我也很忙。#9.1
character_voice.encontent: I'm happy when people ask me for help, even if it's just passing a pen or checking the weather ...#0|You know, the weather in the Wilderness changes all the time, so I'm very busy sometimes.#12.3

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 再混乱复杂的能量到了你附近也会变得平静。#0|我很喜欢坐在你的身边，手臂的振动总是特别令人安心……#7.8|呼——你看，我会变得很想睡觉……#15.1
character_voice.encontent: Even the most chaotic arcane energy acts like a little baby lamb by your side.#0|That's why I like spending time with you; the vibration in my arm is so ... #10.7|*yawn* See? I'm so sleepy ...#21.4

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: 我最近收到了许多表扬，#0|但那个骑摩托的哥哥告诉我，你是这里的老大，你的认可才是最重要的——#3.4|所以，你可以夸我一句吗？#13.2
character_voice.encontent: I've had many compliments recently,#0|but that biker in black said I still need to earn yours because you are the real boss in this place. #6.9|So, could you say something good about me in front of the others?#19.4

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 音叉和三角铁哪个更重要？#0|唔，在重塑乐团的时候，是音叉。乐团只有一个我，#4.1|但三角铁同胞们，一直在换。#13
character_voice.encontent: Which is more important in an orchestra, a tuning fork or a triangle?#0|Mm, as far as I can tell, it was the first one in the Manus—there was only one me there. #10.4|But the triangles, though ... there were always new ones coming.#24.7

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 我和盔甲先生约好了，每周一起保养左手。#0|我想把这件事刻在石板上。在“蜡烛学校”里，大家想记重要的事时就会这样做。#5.1|据说有人为了“节食计划”准备了三百块石板，最后只用了一块。我不能这样……#14.1
character_voice.encontent: Mr. Someone and I agreed to maintain our metal parts together every week.#0|I'm wondering if I should carve it onto a stone tablet to keep myself honest—that's what people do at the "candle school." #10.75|Though I did hear about a student who carved 300 tablets for a long-term diet but only ended up using one ... I can't be like that too.#26.55

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: 苦蜜井大人说，那个舞剧，是我故乡的舞剧。#0|故乡？就是我出生的地方吗？#6.8|是在同一块地方里，大家有着差不多的发色？#11.9|她们提起故乡时，表情有点奇怪……我不知道怎么形容。#18.4
character_voice.encontent: Ms. Bittersweet said this outfit was designed for a comic ballet in my hometown.#0|What is a "hometown"? The place where I was born? #12.3|Is it like everyone who has the same hair color comes from one hometown? #20.5|Hmm ... I asked some of the others about their hometowns, but their faces looked a little strange after ... I don't know why.#30.5

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 是要排演新节目吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: Are we rehearsing a new show?#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 好混乱的振动，我也要加入吗？#0
character_voice.encontent: The vibrations here are all in a mess. Do I have to join?#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: On my toes ...#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 弦乐准备。#0
character_voice.encontent: Strings, be prepared.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 重音！#0
character_voice.encontent: Accent!#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 错误的我。#0
character_voice.encontent: This isn't me.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 发条在转动。#0
character_voice.encontent: Wind it up, and—go.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 声音的纹路。#0
character_voice.encontent: The traces of sound.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 在这里展臂。#0
character_voice.encontent: Stretch your arms.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 可以被看见……#0
character_voice.encontent: The audience is watching ...#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 扯断？扯断——扯断它！#0
character_voice.encontent: Should I break free? Break free ... Break free!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.encontent: Oh no ...#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 唔啊！#0
character_voice.encontent: Whoa!#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 完整的演出……完整的我。#0
character_voice.encontent: A complete performance ... A complete me.#0

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 蓝色的大房间在巴黎只是一个点，巴黎在世界上只是一个点……#0|这是书箱子小姐指给我看的。#8.2|她说，即便是这张地图上的世界，在宇宙里也只是一粒尘埃，#11.6|那我是什么？尘埃的尘埃……的、的尘埃？#19.6
character_voice.encontent: The blue room I used to live in is only a dot on the map of Paris, and Paris is another dot on the world map ...#0|I learned that from Ms. Writing Box. #16.1|She also said that the whole Earth is even smaller than a dot compared to the universe ...#20.8|So, how small am I then? The tiniest dot of all?#33.1

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 离开的方向，属于自己的声音……#0|我以前不明白这些的意义，但我现在想明白。#5.2
character_voice.encontent: Finding what I'm meant to play, playing my own song ...#0|I never really understood what they meant, but ... I think I do now.#9

character_voice.name: 开始交互
character_voice.content: 我为什么必须抬起手？#0
character_voice.encontent: Why do I have to raise my arm?#0

character_voice.name: 交互成功
character_voice.content: 这个瞬间……我会一直记得，#0|记得胸腔里奇怪的振动，记得自己……如何重新找到了我自己。#4
character_voice.encontent: I'll always remember this moment ...#0|With this unusual vibration in my chest, I—I found ... me.#4.6

character_voice.name: 放弃交互
character_voice.content: 好痛，皮肤像被割开，弦在勒住胸口……#0|但是，挣脱的那一刻，“嗡——”突然，世界就安静了。#9.7
character_voice.encontent: Urgh, it was like my skin was being cut open, and there was a string wrapped tight around my chest. It hurt so much,#0|but ... the moment I broke free, I heard an accent—and the world suddenly became so quiet.#21.1

character_voice.name: 入场动画
character_voice.content: 我梦见，我在鸣响，和很多乐器一起鸣响，直到我看见手腕上的丝线……#0|然后梦醒了，原来我在这儿。#13.1
character_voice.encontent: I dreamed of myself playing music with many other instruments; there were strings around my wrists ...#0|Then I woke up and found myself in here.#18.1

skin.name: 珐琅眼
skin.skinDescription: 注意分清她和胡桃夹子。

skin.name: 珐琅眼
skin.skinDescription: 你听到乐器唱歌了吗？那是首关于自我的歌。

skin.name: 醒时声
skin.skinDescription: 与它告别吧，那迷路时一再跌宕的呜咽回声。
skin.skinStory:
“乐器”的数量增加了。
她从混沌与蒙昧中醒来，四周充斥着神秘与疯狂的乐声。她未能理解，只感到无穷的敬畏。最终，意识并未能组织出属于人类的语言。她抬起手，音叉发出了一声嗡鸣——掌声打断了她的第一次“哭啼”。
堆砌着数不清的废弃乐器的石牢之中，小个子大人缓缓地踱步。她需要低音提琴，来探求律的震颤；她需要铜管，来赞颂引导之人的恩德；她需要更多、更多，才能达到极致的美和极致的古典，触及真正的神性……
日日月月的演奏中，神秘术的辉光永不熄灭，而“乐器”也获得了属于自己的启迪。她觉察出一个真正的秘密：她并不是器具，不是小个子大人所说的“天才的乐器”，她能够思考，她能够独立决定。
ㄨㄛˇ、♪♬、嗡——！
面具无法给出答案，命运和花朵正催促她去寻找，就在此刻，就在此时！

1371011.content: ㄗㄠˇ上好！中午好！晚上好！我新学会了这么多用来打招呼的话。
活力？意思是，声音更大、音色更亮吗？
没错，我的手和肚子现在都很有活力！
有！几个女孩、苹果和会飞的朋友，他们和我一起演奏，大家的乐器都很好听。
我学会了好多新曲子，要听吗？给你演奏！
嗯……嗯……一个人合奏，有点困难……

1371012.content: 盔甲先生给了我一瓶油，他让我经常涂在手臂上。
可是我自己总是涂不好，油都漏到衣服上了。
对！他说，涂了这个，金属就不会生锈。
如果之前有这个东西，很多乐器同胞就不用被换掉了。
盔甲先生说，哪怕手臂坏掉，箱子里也有人可以帮我修好。这里真好。
可以吗？会不会耽误你忙大人的事？
盔甲先生还送了我一块软软的布，但是我的关节缝隙太小，布擦不到里面。
如果你能帮我，那就太好啦！

1371011.content: 很高兴看到你这么有活力
还学了什么新的东西吗？
